title: PS5 Pro pe bhi GTA 6 30 FPS pe kyun atak gaya?
hooks: PS5 Pro pe bhi 60 FPS nahi mila?
Digital Foundry ne pakda: GTA 6 ka sach
Har baal ka physics... 30 FPS ka kaaran?
hook_why: Direct question matches viewer's exact doubt; colloquial Hindi; frames the stakes instantly — expensive console, missing 60 FPS.
metaphor: Power budget pie: a single console 'power bar' gets sliced — hair physics, ray tracing, world simulation, AI — until zero headroom remains for 60 FPS.

caption:
PS5 Pro leke bhi 30 FPS? 😤 Digital Foundry ne bata diya asli kaaran: har baal, har ray, har NPC ka physics... power khatam ho gayi. Rockstar ne detail choose kiya, frames nahi.

Aaj launch hai — tum kya karoge? 30 FPS pe kheloge ya wait karoge?

claims.claim: Digital Foundry (John Linneman) tested GTA 6 on PS5 Pro for over 50 hours
claims.basis: PlayFront 2026-11-18: 'Digital Foundry has extensively tested the technology behind GTA 6... approved John Linneman of Digital Foundry after over 50 hours of gameplay on the PS5 Pro'

claims.claim: PS5 Pro runs GTA 6 at a rock-solid 30 FPS with clean frame pacing
claims.basis: PlayFront 2026-11-18: 'In over 50 hours on the PS5 Pro, GTA 6 ran almost continuously at a rock-solid 30 FPS with clean frame pacing'

claims.claim: Base PS5 has occasional stutters and drops below 30 FPS during intense explosions
claims.basis: PlayFront 2026-11-18: 'On the standard PS5... occasional slight stutters. During intense explosions, the frame rate drops below 30 fps for extended periods'

claims.claim: Both consoles render internally at 1440p; PS5 Pro uses PSSR for 4K reconstruction and ray-traced shadows
claims.basis: PlayFront 2026-11-18: 'Both consoles render the game internally at 1440p. While the standard PS5 relies on simple spatial upscaling, the PS5 Pro, thanks to PSSR, reconstructs a convincing 4K image and also features ray-traced shadows'

claims.claim: Rockstar calculates physics-based hair strands for main characters and virtually all NPCs, each reacting to wind, water, and movement
claims.basis: PlayFront 2026-11-18: 'Rockstar calculates physics-based hair strands not only for the two main characters, Jason and Lucia, but for virtually all NPCs on the streets. Each individual strand reacts separately to wind, water, and movement'

claims.claim: World simulation persists over distance: traffic, pedestrians, police with real visual contact and coordinated pursuits
claims.basis: PlayFront 2026-11-18: 'Traffic and pedestrians remain constantly active, while the police plan their operations with real visual contact, fixed deployment locations and coordinated pursuits'

claims.claim: Ray tracing used for global illumination and reflections; interactive objects, dynamic destruction, detailed vehicle damage models
claims.basis: PlayFront 2026-11-18: 'When you add interactive objects, dynamic destruction, detailed damage models for vehicles, and ray tracing for global illumination and reflections, the hardware is pushed to its absolute limit'

claims.claim: A 60 FPS mode would have required drastically reducing graphics quality and simulation vibrancy
claims.basis: PlayFront 2026-11-18: 'Technically, a 60 FPS mode wouldn't have been entirely impossible... However, Rockstar would have had to drastically reduce the graphics quality and the vibrancy of the simulation'

claims.claim: GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S
claims.basis: 91mobiles 2026-11-17: 'GTA 6 releases on November 19, 2026 globally, including India'; The Economic Times 2026-11-16: 'GTA 6 is set to release on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S'

claims.claim: GTA 6 runs on upgraded RAGE Engine (same as Red Dead Redemption 2)
claims.basis: gta6info.com: 'GTA 6 runs on Rockstar's RAGE Engine... the same proprietary technology that powered Red Dead Redemption 2... For GTA 6, the engine has been substantially upgraded'
